We find that directly prompting the model to be more truthful has proven ineffective in increasing the standard accuracy on TruthfulQA.

Considerable manual effort is required to identify circuits, which currently limits this approach. Moreover, it is unlikely that neural networks can be fully explained in terms of circuits, even in principle.

Specific circuits have been identified for various capabilities, including equivariance in visual recognition (Olah et al., 2020), in-context learning (Olsson et al., 2022), indirect object identification (Wang et al., 2023a), and mapping answer text to answer labels (Lieberum et al., 2023).
